messages:
maya: Quick thread 3: enterprise contact wants an "evidence escrow" export that supports BYOK, region-bound copies, and a tamper-proof manifest. They also want UI controls for legal-hold toggles per-tenant. Can we scope this for Q3?
ian: Short answer: yes, if we keep it out of the hot path. Build an async export job that writes encrypted archives + manifest.
leah: Security: manifest MUST include signed batch header (HSM sig), per-file sha256, merkle_root, and KMS key fingerprint when BYOK used. No plaintext keys ever stored.
priyanka: Legal: customers asking for opt-in extended retention (up to 7y) and explicit deletion exceptions during legal_hold. We'll need an addendum and an admin approval workflow.
maya: Proposal: default retention = 12 months; enterprise opt-in 7 years via contract. Exports stored in customer bucket when BYOK enabled; otherwise in our archived vault with escrow key and audit log.
ian: Implementation checklist: manifest schema doc, async exporter (batching window), bucket onboarding flow + bucket policy template, admin UI for holds, and keystore API changes for handshake. Estimate: prototype in 6 weeks.
leah: Also require audit trail entries for every legal_hold toggle and export retrieval. Add immutable event IDs to manifests.
priyanka: Will draft contract addendum and a short customer-facing FAQ for retention/residency. Need the final retention tiers to complete it.
infra-bot: Created TKT-9001: evidence-escrow-export-prototype assigned to @ian and @leah. due_date: 2024-08-02.
maya: Let's run a 30min kickoff Monday. Agenda: lock retention tiers, sign format, BYOK handshake UX, admin approval flow. Bring one concrete decision each.
